trace_css_rules.description: For the first element matching selector, walk every same-origin stylesheet (recursing into @media/@layer/@supports) and return the style rules that set property, plus the element's computed value and inline style.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to inspect.

property.description: CSS property name, camelCase or kebab-case, e.g. "maxWidth" or "max-width".

layout_overflow.description: Report viewport width, document horizontal overflow, and any images under .memo-content or .prose that render wider than their parent (the reading-view breakout images are expected here).

returns.description: {vw, docOverflow, wideImages: [{src, width, parentWidth, naturalWidth, maxWidth}]}
